MarginTrading.bannerDesc: Margin trading creates good opportunities, enhancing investment efficiency but also harboring many risks. Careful learning about margin trading is extremely important to obtain good returns and avoid risks.
MarginTrading.whatIsDesc1: The <bold>HVS</bold> service supports capital for investors in the form of asset margin to trade securities within the regulations of the State Securities Commission. Assets can be cash or securities within <bold>HVS</bold>'s permitted trading list at any given time.
MarginTrading.whatIsDesc2: When using the service, investors deposit an initial amount of cash or permitted securities according to the ratio stated as the initial margin requirement of the securities to be traded. <bold>HVS</bold> lends the remaining part.
MarginTrading.summarySubtitle: Why do investors choose HVS Margin Trading service?
MarginTrading.summaryItem1: Credit limit up to 60 billion VND
MarginTrading.summaryItem2: Loan term of 90 days (extendable by an additional 90 days)
MarginTrading.summaryItem3: Interest calculated from day T + 1 (T is disbursement day)
MarginTrading.summaryItem4: Applies to investors with a securities account at HVS
MarginTrading.summaryItem5: Flexible capital use between accounts, partial withdrawal allowed based on HVS conditions
